atoms.a: What are you most excited about in your future, Cara?
atoms.b: What are you most ((excited)) about in your future, Cara?

atoms.a: Good question, Liam. I think I'm most excited about finding out who I really am. Right now, I feel like everyone expects something from me, and I want to make my own decisions one day.
atoms.b: Good question, Liam. I think I'm most excited about ((finding)) out who I really am. Right now, I feel like everyone expects something from me, and I want to make my own ((decisions)) one day.

atoms.a: I get that. For me, it's more about finally having my own space and not being treated like a kid all the time, even if that also feels a bit scary.
atoms.b: I get that. For me, it's more about finally having my own space and not being treated like a kid all the time, even if that also feels a bit ((scary)).

instruction.text: Welches Bild beschreibt Liams Gedanken am besten? Wähle aus.

atoms.a: Is there anything about the future that you are worried about?
atoms.b: Is there anything about the future that you are ((worried)) about?

atoms.a: Honestly, I'm scared that I'll choose the wrong path after school and regret it later. It feels like everyone expects us to know what we want already.
atoms.b: Honestly, I'm scared that I'll choose the wrong path after school and regret it later. It feels like ((everyone)) expects us to know what we want already.

atoms.a: That's exactly how I feel. Adults always say, “You have so much time,” but at the same time they keep asking what job you want and where you'll study.
atoms.b: That's exactly how I feel. Adults always say, “You have so much time,” but at the same time they keep asking what job you ((want)) and where you'll study.

instruction.text: Was kritisieren die Teenager an ihrem Umfeld?

atoms.a: Yeah, and I'm afraid of becoming someone who only works all the time and forgets what actually makes them happy. I don't want to wake up one day and realise I have wasted years of my life..
atoms.b: Yeah, and I'm afraid of becoming someone who only works all the time and forgets what actually makes them happy. I don't want to wake up one day and realise I have wasted ((years)) of my life.

atoms.a: That's actually something I think about too. I don't need a perfect future — I just hope it feels like it's really mine.
atoms.b: That's actually something I think about too. I don't need a ((perfect)) future — I just hope it feels like it's really mine.

atoms.a: Same. I don't need everything to go exactly as planned, but I want to look back one day and know that I made my own choices.
atoms.b: Same. I don't need everything to go exactly as planned, but I want to look back one day and know that I made my own ((choices)).
